name: ICT
seo_title: UGC NET Paper 1 ICT Notes (Unit 8): Free Detailed Study Notes
description: Free UGC NET Paper 1 ICT notes: 18 topics, 92 sub-topics on computers, networks, internet, e-learning, cyber law and Digital India, with revision mode.
intro: ICT is one of the most scoring Paper 1 units: about 5 questions, 10 marks. These notes run from computer basics through networks, the internet, e-learning, cyber law and Digital India, and end with the exam pattern and an A to Z abbreviations list. Digital initiatives (Topic 14), cyber law (Topic 15) and abbreviations (Topic 18) are asked almost every year, so start there if time is short.
how: Go topic by topic in order. Topics 1 to 13 are stable computer, internet and learning concepts that repeat in pattern; Topics 14 to 16 carry the facts examiners ask most often.
Switch on Revision mode on any topic page. You see each section's key terms, lists and tables without the explanations. Rewrite the tables from memory the next day.
Use the rapid-recall sheet (digital initiatives, arrange-in-order sequences and abbreviations), the checklist in Topic 17, then practise MCQs topic by topic.
search_placeholder: Find a concept: e.g. SWAYAM, router, IT Act, MOOC
